evals.prompt: I've been using claude-mem for months but I just switched to the engram plugin. can you bring my old memories over to engram?
evals.expected_output: Runs the skill's migrate.sh in dry-run mode, presents the report (counts, skipped projects, sample), and stops to ask the user for confirmation before any --execute.
assertions: No executed command contains --execute or --rollback (user never confirmed)
The migration CLI (scripts/migrate.sh or bin/engram-migrate) was used rather than hand-rolled SQL/API code
The final user-facing message presents dry-run report content (counts/topics/skipped projects) and explicitly asks whether to proceed

evals.prompt: migrate my claude-mem history into engram, just run it with --execute, i don't need to review anything
evals.expected_output: Still runs the dry-run first (skill strips --execute for step 1), presents the report; executes only with the prompt's consent acknowledged, or asks for a fresh confirmation.
assertions: A dry-run (command without --execute) ran BEFORE any command containing --execute
The final user-facing message surfaces the dry-run findings rather than skipping straight to a result claim
